handoffs.message: BFF contract, example payloads, and PACKET_FAMILY update published. All three acceptance criteria met: (1) insight aggregation GET /api/v1/knowledge/insights and detail GET /api/v1/knowledge/insights/{insight_id} endpoints defined; (2) filter taxonomy (tag, linked-entity, recency) is backend-owned via filter_metadata; (3) card synthesis eliminates client-side joins — all synthesis is BFF-owned. KW-04 Lovable readiness gate is now true.
Review approved. KW-04 insight contract and example payload are now self-consistent; owner should finalize to done.
